title: someone who isn't selling yet finds the way in

criteria.text: `/you` has no "vendor", "market" or "business owner" and queries none of the dead tables
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] `src/app/you/page.tsx` and what it renders (OwnPages, YouNotices, YouInterests, ZipChange, SearchSharingSwitch, SignOutButton, the Getting updates and Saved rows) show none of the three words; grep of src/app/you and src/components/member finds none outside tests, and the only data read is `members`, `member_notices`, `member_interests`, `saves` (this member's own rows), the `market_name` function and the follows reader. Built in #379 (review-skipped); deploy-health green on 9ff415f and every later /you merge. No standing guard, ticket #582 (open). Smoked: yes, `smoke-live` 2026-11-19 on main 05178ea (routes explore, page, you; personas signedOut, stranger, member, ownerBusiness, operator at 390 and 1280 px; 15 passed, run 44594715209; it checks only that a screen loads with no error and shows no stray email) covers `you` and nothing has changed the criterion since [V].

criteria.text: A Member with no Page sees no shop controls, only their own stuff and one invitation
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] built half: no shop controls on /you. Missing: the invitation. With no Page the section is one line, 'You haven't made a Page yet. Tap Create to start one.' (OwnPages.tsx:139) and 'Start something' is a link in the Your Pages header (you/page.tsx:95); grep for maker, invitation and worked example in src/app/you and src/components/member finds nothing. #15 (T125) was closed 2026-10-18 as 'nothing left to build'; the invitation was never built, so it is refiled as #1011 (open, needs-pm, no comment since filing). The copy is Don's.

criteria.text: The invitation names specific maker categories, with one worked example
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] not built: no maker categories and no worked example anywhere on You (same grep). New user-facing copy, so the wording goes to Don (PM queue). Filed with criterion 2 as #1011.

criteria.text: A Member with Pages sees a row per Page with an Edit control and create controls, reusing the existing query
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] built in #1071 (merged 2026-11-12, #1012 closed by it): an Edit link on each live or archived Page card on You to the Page's own editor (`OwnPages.tsx` editLink, `/g/<id>/edit` or the readable address plus `/edit`); a deleted Page has Restore only; drafts keep Continue and Delete; 'Start something' sits in the section header; the card per Page comes from getOwnPages (#424, #516). Checked: yes for this row: `OwnPages.test.tsx` 'F057 criterion 4a' (two tests) assert the Edit links, the draft and deleted cases; seen failing per the PR body. The marker reads `guards F057.4 partial` only because the listings half is 4b, so the marker cannot say 4a; no `guards F057.4a` form exists. Reviewed: #1071 and #516 carry `Reviewed by:`. Shipped: deploy-health green on 3d665ec. Smoked: yes, `smoke-live` 2026-11-19 on main 05178ea (routes explore, page, you; personas signedOut, stranger, member, ownerBusiness, operator at 390 and 1280 px; 15 passed, run 44594715209; it checks only that a screen loads with no error and shows no stray email) covers `you`, after the 11-12 merge. The 'Edit shop' wording is gone.

criteria.text: A Member with Pages sees their listings on You
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] 'listings' is the vendor-era Items noun (/you/sell still writes Items); the 2026-10-01 ruling on You (#303: private, for the Pages you manage, the Pages you follow, your name and area) names what You holds and listings are not in it, and a Page's products and services now live on the Page itself (#909, #920). No ruling has touched it since. Cannot tell what the criterion asks for on today's model: routed to scope-scenario (the scenario file still reads 'and their listings'; #1012 and the #1071 tests say the same).

criteria.text: `/following` redirects to `/you/following`; sign-out and follow list as shipped
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] redirect in next.config.ts line 26 (direct commit f6b84e0, 2026-09-10, no PR and no deploy-health run, so Reviewed no and Shipped unknown); the follow list was rebuilt in #966 (2026-10-19, Reviewed by: Claude, green on 43bcf96) and relabelled 'Getting updates' in #1172 (2026-11-02, Reviewed by: a second session, green on 49f942f): /you/following lists Pages with Unfollow and Undo through getMemberFollows; `src/app/you/following/page.tsx` has not changed since. SignOutButton on /you. Unmarked tests: tests/retired-routes.test.ts, you-following-row.test.tsx, FollowingManager.test.tsx; no test of sign-out; ticket #583 (open). Smoked: unknown. The 11-19 run covers `you` but not `you-following` (nor `/following`), and no green run has covered it since #1172 changed it [V gh run view].
